params.body:
## What

A **Source** axis on the Mix page. The page takes its axes from `GET /mix`, so it appears without a dashboard change.

Why: on 2026-09-24 a third of the European intake turned out to be one feed, Zeit Online's general news (2,401 signals in a week, 11% kept, average relevance 14: Iran, the G20, handball). By platform and by region the page read that as "DACH is large"; only a source axis makes it visible. That feed has since been switched off with its reason on the row and replaced by ZEIT Campus, the youth section.

## How

`AXES.source` in `packages/core/mix.mjs`: the signal's `source_name`, falling back on `source_id`. About 102 rows for a week, biggest first; 0.25 s on the live table.

`test/mix.test.mjs` pins the axis and the fallback.
params.title: The mix by source: one feed can carry a whole region
